title: Companies that kept the four-day week after the largest multi-country trial
geography: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK, US (141 companies)

source.name: Multi-country four-day workweek trial (141 companies, 2,896 employees)
source.publisher: Boston College researchers, published in Nature Human Behaviour

notes: The largest peer-reviewed four-day workweek trial to date ran 141 companies across six countries for six months; 90% of participating companies kept the schedule permanently afterward.
